body.name: Cert
body.def: \(\operatorname{Cert}_{uv,m,G}(B,Q)\) enumerates real diagonal root branches, eliminates every nonsingular off-diagonal coordinate by the triangular divided-difference recursion, invokes exact CAD on each residual singular system and its two-copy transfer-inequality system, and returns either incompatibility, the common rational transfer, or two exact stable transfer-distinct witnesses.
